protocol.claim: With the latest message and the final-risk label fixed, 90% observation-ID overlap between successive windows degrades a history-summary logistic forecaster (singleton) by more than 0.02 nats of clipped log loss relative to the reuse-invariant latest-message comparator, averaged over independent training banks and scenarios, in the held-out simulator configuration.

configuration.note: Unexposed candidate: noise variance ratio 4 rotated 30 degrees, trace 0.18; bracketed by development ratios 2 and 8.

protocol.label: final recorded log10 risk >= -6 from the full unique-observation posterior (not physical collision occurrence)
protocol.population: Unweighted enriched latent encounter-plane scenarios (30% near-miss component); not operational prevalence.

design.replay_note: Exact replay sends each no-reuse message three times; burst reissue repeats them 2, 1, 3, 1, 2 and 1 times at new publication times.

conditions.label: No reuse
conditions.note: Each message is computed from ten observations that no other message uses.

conditions.label: 50% overlap
conditions.note: Each window shares five of its ten observations with the previous one.

conditions.label: 90% overlap
conditions.note: Each window shares nine of its ten observations with the previous one.

conditions.label: Solution reissue
conditions.note: The same ten-observation solution is published six times.

conditions.label: New information
conditions.note: Each message adds ten new observations to everything seen before.
